methods.source_kernel: calibration_context.mjs dischargeSource/summarize; original exact decimal sums and interpolated daily quantiles
methods.period: Original reference periods and numeric_date_ranges use [start,end); summary.period_end retains the source kernel's inclusive last date
methods.covered_volume: Sum of the original numeric daily means times 0.028316846592 m3/ft3 and a nominal 86400 seconds per reported day; no gap filling or annualization
methods.mapping: Use original explicit flow_station_id; otherwise the same original USGS station ID only. Water-quality station proximity and catchment names never select a gauge
methods.qualification: A/e/P/R flags retain independent source counts; complete numeric support can include estimated or provisional values
methods.source_support: A daily flow period does not alter an admitted observation, load estimator, catchment geometry or original native temporal weighting
